input.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance and Licensee data return/deletion obligation into Article XXI (Effect of Termination)
input.comment: [Playbook] Article XXI only requires us to return Licensor property; it gives us no exit path and no right to recover our own trade and account data held on the Licensed Technology. We have added a reciprocal provision giving up to six months of transition assistance at Licensor's then-current rates, return of our data within 30 days in a machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter; we can accept 90 days of assistance as a fallback provided the 30-day data return stays.

ops.text: Upon the expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Licensor shall (i) at Licensee's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for a period of up to six (6) months at Licensor's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days of such expiration or termination, return to Licensee all Licensee data, trade, order and account records and other Licensee information in Licensor's possession or control, in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete such data, records and information from its systems and certify such deletion in writing to Licensee.
